name: repo-init
description: Create a new GitHub repository with protection already switched on: nobody can push straight to main, every change needs a pull request with 1 approval, CI checks must pass, merges are squash-only, secret scanning and Dependabot alerts are enabled, and merged branches are deleted automatically. Runs one script (needs the gh CLI, logged in) and takes about a minute. It sets up GitHub settings only: it adds no CI workflows, license, security policy or privacy audit. Use it whenever the user wants to create or bootstrap a repo, protect main, or require PRs and approvals.
